item.title: Iran war enters its 6th week as military searches for downed jet crew member
item.summary: The war in Iran enters its 6th week as the search continues for the missing U.S. service member who bailed out of a fighter jet shot down over Iran on Friday.

item.title: Congress gave money for global HIV work. The Trump administration isn't spending it
item.summary: U.S. work combatting HIV/AIDS has saved millions of lives globally. Under the Trump administration, funding has been slow in coming and unpredictable, wreaking havoc on people trying to do the work.

item.title: For artists, the Live Nation trial is just one piece of a difficult touring ecosystem
item.summary: Independent venue closures, social media algorithms and the rise of generative AI are all part of an ecosystem that artists say is becoming increasingly difficult for working musicians to weather.

item.title: Trump's ballroom fight sheds new light on an underground White House bunker
item.summary: The status of a decades-old bunker beneath the now-demolished East Wing is unclear, but the Trump administration has cited security concerns in its legal filings in favor of continuing construction.

item.title: The busiest place you've never seen
item.summary: Photographer Julia Gunther and writer-filmmaker Nick Schönfeld chronicle the rhythms of daily life on Tristan da Cunha, the world's most remote inhabited island.

item.title: Buttercream wool and jelly bean eyes: The art of the Easter lamb cake
item.summary: The cakes – usually baked in the shape of a lamb using a special pan – have a long history in Central Europe, from the German osterlamm, to the Polish baranek wielkanocny, to the Alsatian lammele.

item.title: Tax refunds are trending a bit higher this year. Here's how people are spending them
item.summary: Some people are splurging. Others are finding that their refunds are being swallowed up by the rising cost of gas.

item.title: Dr. Sanjay Gupta explains what we do — and still don't — know about pain
item.summary: "Pain is a mysterious thing," says neurosurgeon Dr. Sanjay Gupta. But understanding how it works in the body and different kinds of treatment can help you find the right pain relief when you need it.

item.title: NASA's Artemis II crew are quite the photographers. See what they've snapped so far
item.summary: Many of the photos that have come out of the moon mission so far were taken by crew members. NASA says the crew is getting guidance from scientists on what to capture when they get closer to the moon.

item.title: When legal sports betting surges, so do Americans' financial problems
item.summary: As online betting has grown in popularity, a new report from the New York Federal Reserve builds on the troubling link between legal sports wagering and financial health.
